title: Terraform storage module: enforce secure defaults, cross-account backup lifecycle, and non-disruptive upgrade path
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a hardened Terraform module for private (VPC) deployment storage primitives that standardizes EBS, EFS, and S3 configuration across Private deployments. The goal is to enforce encryption-at-rest and in-transit by default, provide safe snapshot and backup lifecycle defaults (including cross-account copy where required), add non-destructive upgrade tooling and migration helpers, and include automated health checks and drift detection. This ticket covers the module design, migration strategy for existing stacks, CI+plan checks, and observability hooks for storage health and backup telemetry.
acceptance_criteria: Module exposes secure defaults: EBS volumes with encrypted=true and KMS key rotate enabled or customer-supplied KMS alias
EFS module defaults to encryption in transit (TLS) and encryption at rest using a KMS key; performance_mode and throughput_mode default documented

S3 buckets created by module have server-side encryption AES256 or AWS-KMS with configurable key alias, block public access, mandatory lifecycle rule for transition to cold storage and async deletion after configurable retention
Automated snapshot lifecycle: EBS snapshots created on configurable schedule with tags, retention policy, and optional cross-account copy to customer backup account
Module includes tfplan-time validation and pre-apply checks for potentially destructive changes and provides a migration helper script (terraform state mv pattern) documented
Upgrade path documented for module v1 -> v2 with non-destructive defaults and migration steps; no forced re-creation of existing volumes/buckets unless opt-in
Health check Lambda or agent that runs periodic checks and reports metrics: snapshot age, replication status, bucket encryption status, and EFS mount targets reachable
CI pipeline includes terratest integration that runs modules against a short-lived account and validates core invariants
Security review completed and KMS key policy templates provided for cross-account snapshot copy
Documentation and examples for private deployment repo and sample module consumption in a private cluster stack
tech_notes: We will implement a single Terraform registry module with submodules for ebs, efs, and s3 to keep resource-specific logic isolated. Feature flags will control opt-in behavior (eg. enable_cross_account_copy=false by default). Use lifecycle.ignore_changes for attributes that AWS returns with defaults to avoid spurious diffs (eg. aws_ebs_volume.volume_type after attach). The module will accept either a customer_kms_key_arn or create a namespaced KMS key with key rotation enabled. For EFS, prefer drive-throughput_mode = 'bursting' default; allow throughputs for high IO workloads. For S3, use bucket policies to block public, bucket-level encryption configuration, and default lifecycle rules. Provide a 'migration_helper' terraform script and a small Go CLI wrapper that runs tfstate manipulations for typical move/rename cases. Terratest in CI will use ephemeral accounts (or a pre-provisioned shared sandbox) and mock copies for cross-account tests. Add CloudWatch metrics and a CloudWatch->Prometheus exporter shim to capture snapshot_age_seconds, last_successful_snapshot_timestamp, last_replication_status, bucket_encryption_ok (0/1), efs_mount_ok (0/1).
implementation_steps: Design module API and compile parameter matrix (kms options, retention windows, cross-account settings)
Create submodules: storage/ebs, storage/efs, storage/s3 with clear input/output variables
Implement secure defaults and tfvalidate rules (custom provider check or null_resource + local-exec) to block common misconfigs
Write migration_helper scripts and examples for state moves and renames
Add lifecycle.ignore_changes for AWS-populated attributes and write tests to validate no-drift behavior
Add health-check Lambda (Python) and CloudWatch metric publishing; wire to Console metrics via exporter
Integrate Terratest cases and add PR workflow that runs plan + terratest for module changes
Prepare security review artifacts: KMS policy templates, threat model, and minimal IAM roles for cross-account copy
Author docs + example stacks consumed by private-deploy repo and runbook for emergency restore
Roll out module v2 as opt-in in private clusters, monitor for 2 weeks, then promote opt-in->default if no regressions
test_plan: Unit: terraform validate + fmt + custom tf-lint rules
Integration: Terratest creates resources in sandbox, verifies encryption, snapshot creation, and lifecycle rules
Cross-account: simulate cross-account copy with pre-provisioned backup account credentials and verify copy tags and KMS access
Upgrade test: simulate upgrade from v1 to v2 against existing resources and assert no resource replacements unless opt-in true
Chaos: remove KMS key from policy (negative test) and assert module fails plan with clear error
Health checks: deploy Lambda to sandbox and confirm metrics emitted and alerts triggered on simulated failures
CI gating: PR must pass plan + terratest; any plan suggesting resource destruction must require explicit override label
rollout_plan: Phase 1: Publish module v2-alpha to registry and update private-deploy staging stacks to opt-in flag. Monitor storage health and snapshot telemetry for 2 weeks. Phase 2: Iterate on issues, publish v2-beta, add to more teams as opt-in. Phase 3: After 4 weeks of stable usage and successful upgrade tests, change default opt-in flag to true in private-deploy manifest and announce migration window. Provide 48-hour notice before automated migration; offer manual migration assistance.
